title: Titan Pro 15K Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry combines the brightness of summer berries with the smooth sweetness of ripe Cherry for a layered fruit blend that tastes rich and balanced. The flavour stays vivid and clear thanks to Titan’s mesh-coil precision and auto-feed refill design, which ensures the coil remains perfectly saturated. Each pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container made for the Titan Pro 15K device, offering extended vaping between changes. Tuned for MTL (mouth-to-lung) performance with 20mg Nic Salt, it delivers smooth vapour and full flavour with every puff. Browse the full lineup of Titan Pro 15 pods for even more flavours you’re sure to enjoy. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
